rsvps.message: Heartfelt congratulations, Tewodros & Sara! So sorry I can't be there in person to celebrate with you, but my heart and prayers are with you both. Wishing you a lifetime of joy, peace, and blessings! 🤍🥂
Wishing Dr. Sara and Eng. Tewodros abundant grace, joy, and peace in your holy marriage! May God bless your new home abundantly.
